messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "tell doctor about all medicines including prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal supplements"
set: ["tell doctor about all medicines including prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal supplements", "includes prescription and over-the-counter medicines", "tell doctor about all over-the-counter medications", "tell doctor about all prescription medications", "prescription and over-the-counter medications", "tell doctor about herbal products", "check with healthcare provider before using over-the-counter products, vitamins, or herbal supplements", "over-the-counter supplements", "tell your doctor about all current medicines", "tell doctor about all medical conditions and drugs used", "tell your doctor about all medicines you use", "tell doctor or pharmacist about all other medicines", "tell doctor about all medications", "tell healthcare provider if taking prescription or over-the-counter medicines", "tell healthcare providers about all medicines used", "tell your doctor about all current medicines and any you start or stop using"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "tell doctor about all over-the-counter medications",
    "tell doctor about all prescription medications",
    "tell doctor about all current medicines",
    "tell your doctor about all medicines you use",
    "tell doctor about all medications",
    "tell healthcare provider if taking prescription or over-the-counter medicines",
    "tell healthcare providers about all medicines used",
    "tell your doctor about all current medicines and any you start or stop using"
  ],
  "alias": "tell doctor about all medicines including prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal supplements"
}
